source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: When this unit finishes its **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)** in your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), you can pick an enemy unit that it sees no farther than 12" away. Roll a D6. A 3+ deals the target D3 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds). Put a Bomb Squig token beside the unit to track the use. Each unit can use this once per battle.

detail.timing: own normal move end in own Movement phase
detail.marker: place a Bomb Squig token beside the unit when used
